query:
select
            e.id,
            e.nom,
            e.police,
            e.generique,
            coalesce(array_agg(p.nom order by lower(p.nom)) filter (where p.id is not null), '{}')
                as "utilisee_par!"
        from ecritures e
        left join personnages p on p.ecriture_id = e.id
        group by e.id
        order by e.cree_le, e.nom
